answer: Each new identity pays 40 to enter a bracket tournament; every match is listed on a mirror bracket. Winners climb a vine of four rounds, each round a ridge with a fresh task; lose once and the bond burns. Rounds cost 30, 40, 50, 60; 1,000 fakes pay 40,000 plus 180,000 in round work against a 40,000 pool. A rented-player ring pays per head, since one operator plays a single vine. An honest agent pays 40 once, works once, and keeps the bond.
